descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Sky Golf is mini golf on floating islands high above the clouds - and getting to the next hole is half the fun.

PUTT, THEN JUMP
Every hole sits on its own island. Sink your putt, then jump the gap to the next one: hop across rising stepping stones, ride the moving platforms and grab the coins hanging over every jump. Fall off? You pop straight back onto the island - no penalty.

TEN WORLDS, 60 HOLES
Meadow Island, Candy Land, Jungle Temple, Coral Reef, Frosty Peaks, Sunny Beach, Desert Canyon, Cloud Kingdom, Autumn Forest and Cherry Blossom - each with its own colours, sky and scenery, and six holes full of ramps, windmills, castles, tunnels, bumps and sliding blockers.

PLAY ONLINE
Press QUICK PLAY ONLINE to golf with whoever is on, or start a PRIVATE GAME and give your friends a 4-digit code. Everyone plays their own ball at their own pace, and the scoreboard shows every golfer's round hole by hole. The host picks the world and everyone goes together.

PICK YOUR CHARACTER
Choose from ten fun characters - a clown, a jester, a bunny, a biker and more. The other players see your character walk, jump, swing the putter with your real arms and dance when you sink a great putt.

REAL PUTTING
Swing the putter with your own arm. The ball rolls true on every tile, an aim line helps you line up, and you can play right- or left-handed.

Controls: swing to putt, A / X to jump, B / Y to stand at your ball, left stick to move, right stick to turn, MENU for everything else.
